user.title: Connect to your Den hub
user.description: Home Assistant gets your family's calendars, chores, lists and points from a Den hub on your network.

data_description.url: The hub's address, for example `http://192.168.1.20:47733` or `den.local`. The port defaults to 47733.
data_description.token: In the Den app, a parent opens Settings → AI & automations, adds a token for Home Assistant and copies it here (it's shown once). Give it the scopes read, calendar, chores, lists and points: read alone shows everything but can't change anything. Leave the token's member empty so it acts at parent level and sees the whole family; tie it to a person to see only what they can see.

error.invalid_url: That isn't a web address. Try something like http://192.168.1.20:47733.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach a Den hub at that address. Check that the hub is running and on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The hub didn't accept that token. Copy it again, or create a new one in the Den app.
error.missing_read_scope: That token doesn't have the read scope, which Home Assistant needs.
error.not_ready: The hub isn't set up yet. Finish setting it up in the Den app, then try again.
error.unknown: The hub sent an answer Home Assistant didn't understand. Check that the hub is up to date.

abort.already_configured: This Den hub is already set up.
abort.no_hub_id: The discovered hub didn't say which hub it is. Add it with its address instead.
abort.wrong_hub: That address or token belongs to a different Den hub.

init.title: What Den shows in Home Assistant

data.everyone_on_member_calendars: Show family-wide events on each person's calendar

data_description.members: Each person gets a calendar and sensors for chores and points. People added in Den later show up automatically.
data_description.lists: Each list becomes a to-do list. Lists added in Den later show up automatically.
data_description.everyone_on_member_calendars: Events assigned to no one are for the whole family. They're always on the Family calendar; turn this on to also put them on everyone's own calendar.

abort.not_loaded: Den isn't connected right now. Try again once the hub is reachable.
